PRIVACY & CONTACT

You choose what to share.

Contact the Nobleton.ca team at info@nobleton.ca.

How website forms work

When you submit a business listing, service request or advertising inquiry, the information you enter is sent to Formspree, our form-processing provider, for delivery to the Nobleton.ca team. This includes your name, email address, request details and any business or service-area information you provide. We use this information to review and respond to your inquiry.

Formspree processes submissions and technical information under its privacy policy. The form helper is loaded from the unpkg content delivery network. We do not store form contents in browser storage. Please do not include sensitive information.

Email inquiries

If you send an email, its contents and your email address are delivered through your email provider to info@nobleton.ca. We use inquiries to respond to the relevant request. We ask before sharing personal contact details with a service provider.

Professional inquiries

Real estate and home-evaluation forms are addressed to Ekaterina Ottchenach at realtor@nobleton.ca. Mortgage forms are addressed to Anatoly Shibkov at mortgage@nobleton.ca. The form sends your name, email, optional phone, message, language, source page and property address if you request an evaluation.

Only the selected professional receives the inquiry unless you separately select the optional permission for both professionals. This permission relates to your request; it is not a newsletter subscription. Inquiry delivery uses our WHC hosting and email services. We do not save inquiry contents in a website database or in browser storage. Copies may remain in the receiving mailboxes and mail-service logs.

To limit abuse, the server keeps temporary counters based on a hash of the requesting IP address. Hosting access logs may separately contain technical request details. Contact info@nobleton.ca or the receiving professional to ask about access, correction or deletion of your information.

Calculator and optional analytics

Mortgage estimates are calculated in your browser. We do not send or store the values you enter. Google Analytics 4 loads only after you choose to allow optional analytics. It uses cookies to measure visits and interactions. You can decline or change your choice using Analytics preferences.

Optional analytics record page paths and interaction types, such as a contact click or inquiry submission. Form contents, email addresses, property addresses and calculator amounts are excluded. Search queries are removed from page URLs sent to analytics. External services have their own privacy practices.

Questions or corrections

Email info@nobleton.ca about your information or a directory correction.
